title: 摩根大通戴蒙：AI融资热潮下，信贷利差与估值重估风险正在累积
speaker: Jamie Dimon

segments.en: This conference used to be 20 people, now 2000 investors, and hundreds of companies from around the world.
segments.zh: 这个会议过去只有20人，现在有2000位与会者和来自全球的数百家公司。

segments.en: It is a very positive sign of tech's ability to expand, its diaspora, it's not just Silicon Valley, it's everywhere, so that is a very good sign.
segments.zh: 这是科技扩张能力的积极信号，不再局限于硅谷，而是遍布各地，这是很好的迹象。

segments.en: A lot of these companies, they're real, they're going to invent things that help make mankind for hundreds of years, debt financing is a short-term issue, but rates are going up.
segments.zh: 很多公司是真实的，它们将发明造福人类数百年的东西，债务融资是短期问题，但利率在上升。

segments.en: A lot of them have capital, a lot of government financing, in my view, a little bit expected, if it goes up higher than here, there's a great risk of credit spreads gap.
segments.zh: 很多公司有资本和政府融资，在我看来有点被预期到了，如果利率再走高，信贷利差就有扩大的风险。

segments.en: But yeah, a great risk for all companies, changes in valuations, and then your market's open to close, you know, so there's no permanent state of affairs when it comes to markets.
segments.zh: 对所有公司来说，估值变化是重大风险，市场开盘到收盘都在变，市场没有永恒不变的状态。
